name: Lace Labs
description: Lace is knowledge capture for agent workflows. It learns how your team works as they work, capturing what they see, what they decide, and why, then hands that knowledge to agents so they get it right.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Lace Labs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Lace Labs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.inlace.co/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Lace Labs MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lace Labs provides these MCP tools: apply_comment, list_projects, list_reviews, publish_review, search_comments, and search_discussion.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Lace Labs?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Lace Labs in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Lace Labs MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lace Labs requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Lace Labs is developed by Lace Labs. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
